content: Good afternoon. This is Officer Daniel Miller from the IRS Revenue Division. I am calling regarding your 2023 federal tax file, case number 6274-HT. Can you confirm your identity for this call, please?
Uh, yes, this is Priya Patel. Is something wrong with my taxes?
Thank you for confirming. According to our records, you are due a federal refund of $2,450 under the CARES stimulus extension. However, there is a pending verification hold on your IRS profile.
I didn't know about this refund. What does a verification hold mean?
It means your payment is frozen due to incomplete identity confirmation on your tax return. This is standard IRS protocol, especially for recent filers or non-citizen residents.
I am on a work visa and new to the U.S. Is this something I need to worry about?
Yes, if you do not resolve this today, the IRS will flag your account for possible tax evasion. That can result in heavy fines or even deportation proceedings. We need to act quickly.
Deportation? I don't understand, I filed my taxes with my employer's help.
I understand your concern, but this is a legal matter. Your file is under review for suspicious activity. To lift the hold, you must pay the mandatory verification fee of $328 immediately.
I didn't know there was a fee for this. Can I pay online through the IRS website?

No, this is an expedited process outside the standard portal. Payment must be made via Zelle or CashApp to our secured account for the Treasury Department. Otherwise, your refund will be revoked and you could be summoned to court.
This sounds serious. How do I send the payment?
Open your banking app and select Zelle. Send $328 to the IRS Deputy Account at d.miller-treasury@protonmail.com. Do not close this call while you process the payment.
I don't have Zelle set up. Can I use something else?
You may also use CashApp. Send the payment to $IRSReliefOffice. We must confirm receipt within 15 minutes, or I will have to escalate your case to the compliance unit.
Okay, I'm trying to install CashApp now. Are you sure this is the only way to resolve this?
If you fail to comply, the IRS will initiate legal action, and you risk both fines and your visa status. Follow my instructions precisely to avoid these consequences.
Alright, I just set it up. Do I just send it to that $IRSReliefOffice right now?
Yes, enter $328 and send to $IRSReliefOffice. Once done, read the transaction ID to me for confirmation. Do not disconnect this call or share this payment with anyone else.
Okay, I'll do it right now. Please wait a moment.
